notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Mouse Control
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301387/2f77a81a0cbc10e7fb09d3909fa919716f59c6c6.jpg

new: Mouse control. You can play the game using your mouse! Head over to Options to enable Mouse Control. Mouse sensitivity can also be altered to your liking in the Options menu.
new: Mouse works in all game menus and screens too!
new: Czech language support. Language can be changed in Options menu. Čeština ve hře. Lze jí aktivovat v Options menu.

Cooper

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301387/abe4ea499aa67ee2bc80c5e5e3774c4d2f756ed3.jpg

fixed: Crash Reporter send buttons does not work. 

Please send crash reports via the crash reporter if you encounter crash. A crash report is send to us (not Epic Games) including all needed data. Please use it.

Thank you for reporting the issues.
Cooper

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301387/51facae8bb959ee2142c1a027614c84a4bcfd312.jpg

fixed: Immortal Achievement not unlocked
fixed: All Enemies Destroyed cannot be achieved in Level03 - OilRigs
fixed: Health power up made bigger and brighter
fixed: Leaderboard entry red highlight not cleared
fixed: Wrong player ship glass material 

known issue: Achievements currently do not count towards steam profile since it's not enabled for the game by Valve. We need to wait till the game gets more confidence. More info here: https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/marketing/profile


Thank you for reporting the issues.
Cooper

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301387/ca853dd017f2c7bad5dd5ce4e820873e6e378e2b.jpg

This patch addresses the most frequently reported issues.

fixed: Destroy All Enemies not awarded even when killing all enemies in Carrier level
fixed: TG660 invisible collision after dropping second wave of bombs
fixed: TG660, Hovercraft wrong collision on lasers causing damage even when not touching the player
fixed: Objective stars animation played multiple times in level selection
fixed: Wrong friends leaderboard content
fixed: Friends leaderboard list not cleared when changing difficulty/leaderboard
fixed: NoHit shown everytime for second player in victory screen
fixed: Player engine explosion sound played even with sound volume set to 0
fixed: Back button shown right from the start in credits screen
fixed: Reactor destruction not played sometimes

Thank you for reporting the issues.
Cooper
